title: Annotatio IV §.III from Posterior [1]: Abound in one’s own sense; instill novelties to the church’s hurt
pass_a_gloss: From the posterior [1.] To abound in one’s own Sense, and in good faith to instill one’s novelties into others, to the prejudice of the Church and of Ecclesiastical Peace.
pass_b_english: From the second fountain: [1.] Swell with your own sense, and in good faith drip your novelties into others — to the hurt of the church and of church peace.
source_text: Ex posteriori [1.] Sensu suô abundare, novitates suas bonâ fide aliis instillare, in Ecclesiae Pacisque Ecclesiasticae praejudicium.
